children: For Morgans, a big takeaway from Baby Bunting's trading update is how well newly refurbished stores are performing. Baby Bunting said comparable sales growth slowed to 2.2% in the first 14 weeks of FY27, from 4.3% in the opening six weeks. Still, analyst Emily Porter zeroed in on the 17 stores converted to the Store of the Future format. These achieved average sales growth of 20% in the first year after reopening, bang in the middle of the company's 15%-25% target range. "We expect earnings growth into FY27, driven by Store of the Future," says Morgans, which rates Baby Bunting's stock a "buy." (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
